tagline_en: Intensive hydration that locks in moisture for soft, luminous skin
tagline_zh: 密集补水 · 锁水保湿 · 柔嫩透亮
overview_en: Rich in assorted plant essences and hyaluronic water molecules that penetrate deep into the skin for lasting hydration and a balanced, even complexion.
overview_zh: 含有丰富的各种植物精华和水分子玻尿酸，能更好地渗透肌肤，为肌肤提供持久保湿，最终达到肤色平衡。
benefits_en: Locks in hydration and prevents water loss
Leaves skin softer, finer and more radiant
Recommended as a 7-day intensive hydration course
benefits_zh: 肌肤更柔嫩、细致、有光泽
建议连续7天密集补水护理
how_to_use_en: Use for 7 consecutive days as an intensive hydration course.
how_to_use_zh: 建议连续使用7天作为密集补水护理
